defect: A boundary or status frame can stop subscription retries even though the server broadcasts these frames to unregistered sessions. Initial fallback records also do not prove registration.
fix: Refresh SUBSCRIBE every 3000 ms for the lifetime of a subscribing session. Reset the cadence on connection. Keep replay acknowledgements separate. Duplicate server registration leaves the cached targets intact.
impact: One small control message and existing status answer per subscribing session per interval. Publisher-only sessions send none. No transaction, stored, or wire-format changes.

negative.mutation: Preserve previous confirmation policy in extracted request state; boundary kind 2 prematurely stops refresh.

limitations: No local cluster started. Rust tests use production request state; Java tests use real service logic with stub sessions.
No specific deployed outage is yet attributed to this defect. Live failure and performance validation remain required.
Initial extraction compile error was corrected before the recorded negative control and final tests.
